text:
maria: Heads-up — spotted a perf regression rolling out fused-RoPE + FlashAttention-v2 on the 1.5B test fleet. Latency p50 jumped ~12% for seq_len=2048 with rotary_dim=64 versus baseline.

eli: :eyes: do you have the perf numbers and kernel selection logs?

maria: Quick notes:
- baseline: FlashA-v1 + non-fused RoPE -> p50 78ms
- experiment: FlashA-v2 + fused-RoPE -> p50 88ms
- batch sizes similar, kv-cache hitrate unchanged

maria: Profiler snapshot (reduced):
```
ATTN_KERNEL chosen: flash_v2_fusedrope
matmul_forward  32ms
flash_forward   44ms  <-- up from 34ms previously
kv_lookup       6ms
other overhead  6ms
```

todd: interesting — could be rotary-multipliers forcing extra transposes or an extra kernel path for certain rotary_dim values. Which rotary_dim did you use?

maria: rotary_dim=64. Also tried rotary_dim=32 and perf returned closer to baseline (p50 80ms). Looks like the fused path has a cost that amortizes only for larger rotary_dims.

eli: Paging + cache layout could also change kernel tiling. Did paged-attention get enabled in this build? I remember a recent change where paged logic flips to a slower fallback for odd rotary dims.

maria: Yes, paged-attn=on for these runs. I toggled it off and fused-RoPE + FlashA-v2 improves to p50 82ms. So paged-attention interaction seems important.

nina: @maria can you upload the full profiler traces? I'll run the kernel-level flame graph and check for extra copies/transposes.

maria: uploaded to s3://redwood-perf/1763421987/trace.zip

infra-bot: Deploy log: build/flashattn-v2+fusedrope #342 -> rolled to canary (10 nodes)

todd: quick mitigation: pin FlashA to v1 on canary and force non-fused-rope path for rotary_dim<=64 until we root cause. Also add an heuristics tweak: prefer non-fused kernel if paged-attention enabled and rotary_dim % 32 != 0.

eli: For rerun, run this micro-benchmark:
```
./bench_attention --model transformer_small --seq 2048 --rot_dim 64 --kernel flash_v2_fusedrope --paged true --iters 200
```
Include `--trace-kernel` to dump kernel timings.

maria: Will run. I'll also check kv-cache alignment — saw a ~1KB shift in cache pointers in one trace which might force an extra memcpy.

nina: If memcpy is the culprit we can push a cheap alignment shim in the runtime until kernel is patched.

maria: Adding ticket PERF-ML-1912 with data + s3 link. I'll paste micro-benchmark results here when done. Thanks all :thumbsup:

eli: Nice triage. If you need me to repro locally I can spin up a GPU with pinned build.

maria: Will take you up on that. Last note: regression only hit on p50/p90 tail when concurrent batching > 8. Single-request latencies are less affected. So batching heuristic + kernel path interplay is critical.

todd: Filed a short rollback PR and a feature-flag path to opt-out fused-RoPE for now. :ok_hand:

maria: Closing loop — follow-ups: kernel flamegraph, kv alignment check, paged-attn heuristic fix, rollback PR. Thanks.
